blurb: Longbow Golf Club offers 18-hole rounds bookable up to 90 days in advance and morning 9-hole rounds bookable up to 7 days in advance. The course features a redesigned 7,050-yard layout suitable for all skill levels, a full-service restaurant and bar with a year-round patio, and a premier practice facility with driving range and short game areas.
